title: The official Erdos Problems page returns HTTP 403 to this auditor

impact: Nonblocking. The substantive open-status claim is supported by the verified primary source [1] (Erdos-Ordman-Zalcstein 1993), whose abstract was retrieved verbatim from the publisher record and states 'It is unknown whether this many cliques will always suffice.'
